description: Actual vs LP-optimal dispatch revenue, per-DUID summary, over a date range (energy-only, perfect-foresight benchmark). NOT a revenue-total source — use get_battery_revenue for that. Both the 'actual' AND the 'optimal' figures here are MLF-adjusted (get_battery_revenue's is gross) — the LP's objective is solved on MLF-adjusted prices, not just settled at them afterward — and both cover solved LP days only (days where the solver failed are dropped from both), so the two tools' totals will not match even for the same DUID and date range. The requested date_to may also be silently truncated to the latest date with sufficient fleet-wide LP coverage. Pass duid to restrict to one battery — omitting it scans every DUID and can time out even on a ~3-week range; even a single-DUID, single-month scan has been observed to time out, so keep date ranges short and retry narrower on a timeout.

duid.description: Battery DUID, e.g. HPR1 (optional — omit for all DUIDs)

name: get_battery_optimal
title: Actual vs optimal dispatch revenue
